evidence.quote: Now, turning to the main theme of my remarks today, I will discuss the imperative of fostering innovation in the banking system.
The U.S. banking system remains resilient and on a solid foundation, with strong capital and liquidity throughout the system.
The Federal Reserve Board announced that it will make additional funding available to eligible depository institutions through a newly created Bank Term Funding Program.
